description: A plan that fully covers its spec — every component present, every flow step an edge, every node grouped. The validator should find nothing.

input.request: draw an order pipeline with checkout, payment and a receipt notification
input.spec_markdown:
TITLE: Order Pipeline
TYPE: workflow
COMPONENTS:
- Checkout (client) - web
- Payment Service (service) - POST /pay
- Ledger (datastore) - -
- Receipt Email (external) - -
FLOW:
1. Checkout -> Payment Service: charge
2. Payment Service -> Ledger: record
3. Payment Service -> Receipt Email: notify
PHASES:
1. Purchase: Checkout, Payment Service
2. Settlement: Ledger, Receipt Email
ASSUMPTIONS:
- Payments are card-only.
